https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-assessmen.notes: Advice MAP -> oec:testedConditions. The upstream property links an assessment execution to the condition under which it is performed, which aligns with our existing property oec:testedConditions that describes the conditions under which performance was tested.
Advice MAP -> eucpr:hasCharacteristicValue. Both properties relate a measurement result to its quantitative value; eucpr:hasCharacteristicValue already captures this relationship.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-associate.notes: Advice MAP -> euelec:hasComponentType. The upstream property links a non‑textile component to its type concept, which is already represented by euelec:hasComponentType in our vocabulary.
Advice MAP -> eutex:chemicalPurpose. The upstream property describes the functional role of a textile chemical substance, which is already represented by eutex:chemicalPurpose in our vocabulary.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-connector.notes: Advice MAP -> oec:SingleValuedDataElement. The upstream class represents a numerical value with unit, which is already captured by oec:SingleValuedDataElement in our vocabulary.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-context#h.notes: Advice MAP -> eucpr:hasCharacteristicValue. Both properties link a context observation to a quantitative value; eucpr:hasCharacteristicValue is the existing DPP term that captures this relationship.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-core#Reus.notes: Advice OUT_OF_SCOPE. The upstream class represents a product type that is explicitly excluded from the DPP scope, so it does not need to be modeled in the vocabulary.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-core#hasF.notes: Advice MAP -> oec:massFraction. The upstream property describes the mass fraction of a fibre component, which is directly represented by our existing term oec:massFraction.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-core#hasT.notes: Advice MAP -> oec:massFraction. The upstream property describes the mass fraction of textile fibres, which is directly represented by our existing term oec:massFraction.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-core#jrcE.notes: Advice MAP -> eudr:exemptionReasonCode. The upstream property captures a coded reason for excluding a textile product class from the JRC study scope, which is functionally equivalent to an exemption reason code in our vocabulary.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Advice MAP -> eutex:hasDurabilityInfo. The upstream property ‘has durability aspect’ directly corresponds to the existing DPP class property eutex:hasDurabilityInfo, which links a textile product to its durability metrics.

Advice MAP -> eutex:hasDurabilityInfo. The upstream property ‘has observed performance parameter’ is effectively covered by the existing DPP property eutex:hasDurabilityInfo, which links a textile product to its durability metrics and observed performance data.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-indicator.notes: Advice MAP -> oec:stageValue. The upstream property links an Indicator to a generic quantitative value, which is functionally equivalent to our oec:stageValue that represents an indicator’s quantitative value for a lifecycle module.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#D.notes: Advice MAP -> eubat:TemperatureRange. The upstream term represents a temperature parameter for dyeing, which aligns with the existing TemperatureRange class in our vocabulary; no new term is required.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#T.notes: Advice MAP -> eubat:TemperatureRange. The upstream concept of Temperature control is effectively the same as the existing eubat:TemperatureRange, which captures a temperature range specification for an operating context.
Advice CARRIER -> EPCIS event. A concrete occurrence of a textile process is naturally represented by an EPCIS event, which already captures the execution details within the DPP data exchange.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#U.notes: Advice CARRIER -> CBV bizStep use. The ‘Use or wear process’ is a lifecycle stage that can be represented by the existing CBV bizStep ‘use’, which already captures use‑phase events in EPCIS.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#h.notes: Advice MAP -> eutex:hasCareInstructions. The upstream property ‘has care instruction’ is equivalent to the existing eutex:hasCareInstructions, which already captures product‑specific care instructions.

Advice MAP -> eucpr:hasCharacteristicValue. The upstream property links a process parameter setting to a quantitative value, which is conceptually equivalent to the existing eucpr:hasCharacteristicValue property that associates a quantitative value with an essential characteristic.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#i.notes: Advice CARRIER -> EPCIS productEvent. The upstream property simply links a textile process execution to the EPCIS product event that records it, which is already represented by the standard EPCIS productEvent construct.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#r.notes: Advice CARRIER -> EPCIS productEvent. The upstream property simply links a product event to the textile process execution it records, which is already represented by the standard EPCIS productEvent construct.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#u.notes: Advice MAP -> eutex:chemicalPurpose. The upstream property ‘uses chemical function’ aligns with the existing DPP term eutex:chemicalPurpose, which captures the technical purpose of a chemical in textile processes.

Advice MAP -> eutex:hasTextileChemicals. The upstream property ‘uses chemical substance’ describes chemicals employed in a textile process, which is effectively the same concept as eutex:hasTextileChemicals – chemicals used in textile production.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-recyclabi.notes: Advice MAP -> eutex:RecyclabilityAssessment. The upstream Recyclability class matches the existing eutex:RecyclabilityAssessment, which captures a product’s potential for recycling under specified contexts.

Advice CARRIER -> EPCIS event with CBV bizStep recycling. The concept represents a specific type of EPCIS event; it is already covered by the generic EPCIS event construct with an appropriate bizStep.

Advice CARRIER -> EPCIS event with CBV bizStep recycling. The concept represents a specific type of EPCIS event; it is already covered by the generic EPCIS event construct with an appropriate bizStep.
Advice CARRIER -> EPCIS event with CBV bizStep recycling. The concept is an occurrence of textile recycling, which is already represented by a generic EPCIS event with the appropriate bizStep.

Advice MAP -> eutex:hasSortingFactors. The upstream property ‘applies sorting criterion’ is conceptually equivalent to the existing eutex:hasSortingFactors, which captures sorting factors used in recycling processes.

Advice MAP -> eutex:hasRecyclabilityAssessment. The upstream property ‘assesses recyclability of’ directly corresponds to the existing eutex:hasRecyclabilityAssessment, which links a textile product to its recyclability assessment.

Advice MAP -> euelec:hasMaterialRecoveryResults. The property euelec:hasMaterialRecoveryResults captures the measured outcome of a textile recycling event, including recovered material outputs, matching the upstream hasRecoveredMaterial concept.

Advice MAP -> eutex:hasRecyclabilityAssessment. The upstream property hasRecyclabilityAspect corresponds to the existing eutex:hasRecyclabilityAssessment, which links a product to its recyclability assessment.

Advice MAP -> oec:recyclabilityScore. The upstream hasRecyclabilityScore directly corresponds to the existing oec:recyclabilityScore property, which captures a numeric recyclability score for a product.

Advice MAP -> eutex:hasWasteOriginType. The upstream concept of a waste source type (lifecycle‑stage category where the textile became waste) aligns with our existing Waste Origin Type classification, so mapping is appropriate.

Advice MAP -> euelec:recyclingProcess. The upstream property links a recycling route to its principal recycling process type, which matches the existing euelec:recyclingProcess property that describes the treatment or recycling process applied to an item.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-repairabi.notes: Advice MAP -> oec:RepairabilityInfo. The upstream Repairability concept is equivalent to the existing oec:RepairabilityInfo class, which already represents repair and maintenance information per ESPR Article 7.
Advice MAP -> euelec:repairType. The upstream property describes the type of repair action performed, which aligns with our existing euelec:repairType that captures the kind of repair performed.

Advice MAP -> oec:hasRepairInstructions. The upstream property ‘has repair guidance’ is functionally equivalent to our existing oec:hasRepairInstructions, which links a product to repair instructions or manuals.

Advice MAP -> oec:hasSparePartsAvailability. The upstream ‘has spare‑part availability condition’ is functionally equivalent to our existing oec:hasSparePartsAvailability, which records the duration for which spare parts will be available.

Advice MAP -> oec:hasRepairProvider. The upstream ‘provided by’ property is functionally equivalent to our existing oec:hasRepairProvider, which links a product (or service) to one or more authorised repair providers.

Advice MAP -> oec:hasRepairInstructions. The upstream ‘provides guidance’ property is functionally equivalent to our existing oec:hasRepairInstructions, which links a repair service (or product) to the URL or reference of repair instructions and manuals.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Advice MAP -> eucpr:hasCharacteristicValue. The upstream property ‘has characteristic value’ is a generic quantitative link between a textile structure characteristic and its numeric value, which matches the existing eucpr:hasCharacteristicValue construct.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:AbrasionResistance (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:AbrasionResistance. Observed performance parameter describing the resistance of a textile material or product to wear caused by rubbing or abrasion.

Proposal: eutex:AccidentalDamage (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:AccidentalDamage. External damage occurring during use, such as accidental tearing, ripping or staining, which may lead to product rejection or disposal.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-assessmen.notes: Proposal: eutex:AgeingSimulationMethod (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:AgeingSimulationMethod. A laboratory or field test method that applies controlled, repeatable use or care cycles to simulate product ageing before or during durability assessment.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Proposal: eutex:AssemblyCharacteristic (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:AssemblyCharacteristic. Characteristic of a garment or textile assembly, covering seams, sewing and cutting quality.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-assessmen.notes: Proposal: eutex:AssessmentCondition (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:AssessmentCondition. The set of environmental, operational or procedural parameters under which an assessment is performed or a result is obtained.

Proposal: eutex:AssessmentExecution (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:AssessmentExecution. The actual performance of a textile assessment method on a specified product under defined conditions and parameter settings.

Proposal: eutex:AssessmentMethod (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:AssessmentMethod. A documented procedure or approach used to assess, observe, test, measure or evaluate a textile product or a durability‑related performance parameter.

Proposal: eutex:AssessmentParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:AssessmentParameter. A configurable value or setting that influences how a textile assessment procedure is carried out, interpreted or qualified.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#C.notes: Proposal: eutex:CareMethodConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:CareMethodConcept. Controlled vocabulary concept representing a textile care method, such as washing or drying instructions.
Proposal: eutex:CareParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:CareParameter. Process parameter relevant to textile care, such as washing temperature, drying time or storage conditions.

Proposal: eutex:ChemicalFinishingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ChemicalFinishingProcess. Finishing process that uses chemical substances or treatments to confer or modify functional properties of textile materials or products.

Proposal: eutex:CleaningProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:CleaningProcess. Care process involving domestic laundering, professional cleaning, dry cleaning or wet cleaning of a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:CoatingAdditiveUse (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:CoatingAdditiveUse. Process‑level record of an additive or chemical used to coat a textile material, capturing the role rather than the substance itself.

Proposal: eutex:CoatingParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:CoatingParameter. Process parameter relevant to textile coating or surface treatment, such as thickness, cure time or temperature.

Proposal: eutex:CoatingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:CoatingProcess. Finishing process that applies a coating layer or functional surface treatment to a textile material or product.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-recyclabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:CollectionSchemeConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:CollectionSchemeConcept. Concept used to classify an arrangement for collecting textile waste.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:ColourDepthEvenness (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ColourDepthEvenness. Observed visual performance parameter describing the depth and evenness of colour in a textile product or fabric, especially in relation to dyeing and finishing quality.
Proposal: eutex:ColourFading (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ColourFading. Visual failure mode corresponding to progressive loss of colour intensity during use, washing, ageing or exposure.

Proposal: eutex:ColourFastness (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ColourFastness. Observed performance parameter describing the resistance of a textile colour to fading, running or alteration under conditions such as washing, rubbing, perspiration or light exposure.
Proposal: eutex:ComponentFailureMode (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ComponentFailureMode. Category of failure modes affecting components or trims in textile products.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#C.notes: Proposal: eutex:ConfectioningParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ConfectioningParameter. Process parameter relevant to garment making, cutting, sewing, assembly or make‑up operations.

Proposal: eutex:ConfectioningProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ConfectioningProcess. Manufacturing process that transforms fabrics and components into finished textile apparel or articles, including cutting, sewing and make‑up operations.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Proposal: eutex:CutPrecision (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:CutPrecision. Assembly characteristic describing the precision of cutting or pattern construction in a textile product.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#C.notes: Proposal: eutex:CuttingParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:CuttingParameter. Confectioning parameter relevant to cutting operations.
Proposal: eutex:CuttingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:CuttingProcess. Confectioning process in which textile materials are cut into components or pattern pieces.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#D.notes: Proposal: eutex:DefectControl (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:DefectControl. Process parameter or quality‑control practice aimed at preventing or detecting defects during textile processing.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:DeformationPerformanceParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:DeformationPerformanceParameter. Category of observed performance parameters related to deformation, shape retention or dimensional behaviour.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-indicator.notes: Proposal: eutex:DegradationRate (class) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:DegradationRate. Calculated indicator expressing change in a performance parameter or degradation phenomenon per stated unit of time, use, cycle or exposure.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:DimensionalStability (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:DimensionalStability. Observed performance parameter describing the ability of a textile product or fabric to retain its dimensions after use, laundering or other treatment cycles.

Proposal: eutex:Discolouration (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:Discolouration. Observed performance parameter describing localised, irregular or use‑specific colour change that is distinct from general colour fading.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#D.notes: Proposal: eutex:DryingTemperature (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:DryingTemperature. Care parameter describing the temperature used during textile drying.
Proposal: eutex:DyeConcentration (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:DyeConcentration. Dyeing parameter describing the concentration of dye or colourant used in a textile dyeing process.
Proposal: eutex:DyeingParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:DyeingParameter. Process parameter relevant to textile dyeing.
Proposal: eutex:DyeingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:DyeingProcess. Wet processing process used to impart colour to textile fibres, yarns, fabrics or finished products.
Proposal: eutex:DyeingTime (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:DyeingTime. Dyeing parameter describing the duration of a dyeing process or dyeing step.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:ElasticityLoss (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ElasticityLoss. Structural failure mode describing loss of elastic recovery or stretch‑related functionality in a textile product or fabric.

Proposal: eutex:ExternalDamage (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ExternalDamage. Damage caused by external or accidental events during product use, not necessarily resulting from intrinsic lack of durability.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Proposal: eutex:FabricAppearance (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricAppearance. Visual characteristic describing the overall visible appearance or visual quality of a fabric.

Proposal: eutex:FabricBehaviouralCharacteristic (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricBehaviouralCharacteristic. Physical behaviour of a fabric under use, gravity, movement, care or stress conditions.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:FabricBreakdown (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricBreakdown. Aggregated failure mode of a textile fabric that may later be decomposed into specific phenomena such as fraying, thinning, localised wear or hole formation.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Proposal: eutex:FabricBreathability (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricBreathability. Functional characteristic of a fabric describing the passage of water vapour and evaporative cooling.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#F.notes: Proposal: eutex:FabricConstructionParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricConstructionParameter. Process-side parameter describing how a fabric construction is specified or controlled during manufacturing. The resulting observable construction characteristics are represented in TEXTILE_STRUCTURE.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Proposal: eutex:FabricDrape (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricDrape. Behavioural characteristic describing how a fabric hangs in three dimensions and conforms to contours.
Proposal: eutex:FabricElasticity (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricElasticity. Structural characteristic describing the elastic behaviour of a fabric.

Proposal: eutex:FabricFunctionalCharacteristic (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricFunctionalCharacteristic. Characteristic describing the functional performance of a fabric relevant to use, comfort or intended application.
Proposal: eutex:FabricHandle (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricHandle. Tactile characteristic of a fabric describing softness, smoothness, flexibility and overall sensation when touched.
Proposal: eutex:FabricInsulation (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricInsulation. Functional characteristic of a textile that describes its ability to retain heat and reduce heat transfer.
Proposal: eutex:FabricLustre (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricLustre. Visual characteristic of a textile that describes the reflection of light producing a shiny or glossy appearance.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#F.notes: Proposal: eutex:FabricManufacturingMethodConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricManufacturingMethodConcept. SKOS concept used as a controlled value for a fabric manufacturing method.

Proposal: eutex:FabricManufacturingParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricManufacturingParameter. Superclass covering process‑side parameters used during fabric manufacturing, excluding resulting structural characteristics.

Proposal: eutex:FabricManufacturingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricManufacturingProcess. Manufacturing process that transforms yarns, fibres or filaments into fabric structures.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Proposal: eutex:FabricMassPerUnitArea (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricMassPerUnitArea. Construction characteristic expressing the mass of a fabric per unit surface area.
Proposal: eutex:FabricRigidity (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricRigidity. Structural characteristic indicating the stiffness or resistance to deformation of a textile.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:FabricSmoothness (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricSmoothness. Observed performance parameter describing the visible or tactile smoothness of a fabric surface, commonly assessed during visual inspection after washing, drying or other durability‑related stress.

Proposal: eutex:FabricStrength (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricStrength. Aggregated observed mechanical performance parameter describing the strength of a fabric, covering tensile, tear or bursting strength as appropriate to the test context.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Proposal: eutex:FabricTactileCharacteristic (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricTactileCharacteristic. Fabric-level characteristic concerning touch, hand‑feel or perceived tactile behaviour.

Proposal: eutex:FabricVisualCharacteristic (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FabricVisualCharacteristic. Fabric-level characteristic concerning visible appearance, lustre, shininess, sheen or other visual qualities.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:FailureMode (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FailureMode. A specific event or condition that causes a textile product to fail, distinct from the performance parameters that describe its normal behaviour.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Proposal: eutex:FibreCharacteristic (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FibreCharacteristic. Characteristic of a textile fibre that influences yarn manufacture, fabric behaviour and durability-related performance.

Proposal: eutex:FibreCleanliness (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FibreCleanliness. Quality characteristic of a textile fibre describing the presence of impurities or foreign matter remaining in the fibre.
Proposal: eutex:FibreColour (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FibreColour. Visual characteristic of a textile fibre describing its colour and how that influences dyeing or bleaching behaviour.

Proposal: eutex:FibreElasticity (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FibreElasticity. Mechanical property of a textile fibre describing its ability to deform under load and recover when the load is removed.
Proposal: eutex:FibreFineness (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FibreFineness. Structural property of a textile fibre expressed as linear density or fineness.
Proposal: eutex:FibreLength (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FibreLength. Structural property of a textile fibre expressed as the length of the individual fibre.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#F.notes: Proposal: eutex:FibrePreparationProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FibrePreparationProcess. Manufacturing process that prepares fibres for yarn manufacturing or textile production.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Proposal: eutex:FibreQualityCharacteristic (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FibreQualityCharacteristic. Non‑structural, non‑mechanical, non‑physical or visual property of a textile fibre that influences its overall quality.
Proposal: eutex:FibreSectionShape (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FibreSectionShape. Cross‑sectional shape of a textile fibre, such as round, oval or irregular.
Proposal: eutex:FibreStrength (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FibreStrength. Mechanical property of a textile fibre describing its resistance to tensile stress or breakage.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#F.notes: Proposal: eutex:FinishingParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FinishingParameter. Process parameter relevant to textile finishing, including chemical and mechanical finishing.

Proposal: eutex:FinishingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FinishingProcess. Textile process applied to modify appearance, handle, function or physical properties of textile materials or products.

Proposal: eutex:FinishingTreatmentParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FinishingTreatmentParameter. Process parameter describing a finishing treatment type, intensity, duration or configuration.

Proposal: eutex:FixationCondition (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FixationCondition. Dyeing or printing parameter describing conditions used to fix a dye, pigment, print or finish to the textile material.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:FunctionalFailureMode (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FunctionalFailureMode. A failure mode that primarily results in loss of intended use, comfort or functional suitability of a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:FuzzingOrMatting (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:FuzzingOrMatting. Observed surface degradation phenomenon involving fuzzing or matting of the fabric surface, following JRC and ISO wording.
Proposal: eutex:HoleInSeam (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:HoleInSeam. Specific seam failure involving a hole or localized opening at or around a seam.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#H.notes: Proposal: eutex:HumidityControl (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:HumidityControl. Process parameter describing control of humidity during textile manufacturing, processing or care.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#I.notes: Proposal: eutex:IncinerationProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:IncinerationProcess. End‑of‑life process involving combustion of textile products or textile waste.

Proposal: eutex:InputYarnCountSpecification (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:InputYarnCountSpecification. Process target or input specification stating the yarn count or yarn linear‑density class selected for fabric manufacturing.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Proposal: eutex:IntermediateTextileCharacteristic (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:IntermediateTextileCharacteristic. Property of an intermediate textile structure such as yarn, fabric or assembly that is not a final product but influences performance.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-assessmen.notes: Proposal: eutex:InterpretationScale (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:InterpretationScale. A numeric or categorical scale used to interpret, classify or rate the result of a textile assessment.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#I.notes: Proposal: eutex:IroningProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:IroningProcess. Confectioning or care‑related process applying heat and pressure to shape, smooth or finish textile products.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#K.notes: Proposal: eutex:KnittingPatternSpecification (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:KnittingPatternSpecification. Process target specification stating the knitting structure or pattern to be produced.

Proposal: eutex:KnittingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:KnittingProcess. Fabric manufacturing process in which yarns are interlooped using needles to form fabric on knitting machines.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#L.notes: Proposal: eutex:LaminatingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:LaminatingProcess. Finishing or assembly process joining textile materials with layers or membranes.
Proposal: eutex:LandfillingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:LandfillingProcess. End‑of‑life process involving disposal of textile products or textile waste in landfill.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-repairabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:LifeExtensionInterventionAspect (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:LifeExtensionInterventionAspect. Product aspect concerning intervention‑based extension or restoration of textile product use, functionality or value through repair, upgrade, refurbishment or remanufacturing.

Proposal: eutex:LifeExtensionProductEvent (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:LifeExtensionProductEvent. Concrete textile process occurrence that extends, restores or substantially changes the useful life, functionality or condition of a textile product.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#L.notes: Proposal: eutex:LiquorRatio (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:LiquorRatio. Dyeing‑process parameter expressing the relation between the quantity of treatment liquor and the mass of dry textile material, with explicit reporting basis and unit.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:LogoFailure (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:LogoFailure. Failure of a logo on a textile product, whether printed, embroidered or applied as a separate component.

Proposal: eutex:LossOfComfort (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:LossOfComfort. Functional failure mode indicating a loss of comfort or comfort‑related suitability during use, maintenance or ageing.

Proposal: eutex:LossOfDimensionalStability (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:LossOfDimensionalStability. Failure mode indicating a textile product’s inability to retain its dimensions after use, laundering or treatment cycles.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#M.notes: Proposal: eutex:MachineryCharacteristic (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:MachineryCharacteristic. Process parameter or equipment characteristic describing machinery quality, configuration or components relevant to textile processing.

Proposal: eutex:MaintenanceAndRepairProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:MaintenanceAndRepairProcess. Process that extends product lifetime through maintenance or repair activities, distinct from assessment indicators.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-recyclabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:ManufacturerDeclarationVerificationMethod (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ManufacturerDeclarationVerificationMethod. Verification method based on a declaration made by the manufacturer.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-assessmen.notes: Proposal: eutex:MeasurementParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:MeasurementParameter. A protocol variable that is controlled or recorded during a measurement or test, distinct from the product performance characteristic being assessed.

Proposal: eutex:MeasurementParameterSetting (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:MeasurementParameterSetting. A concrete assignment of a quantitative or controlled value to a measurement parameter within an assessment execution or protocol.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:MechanicalFailureMode (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:MechanicalFailureMode. Category of failure modes primarily involving rupture, tearing or other mechanical damage to a textile product.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#M.notes: Proposal: eutex:MechanicalFinishingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:MechanicalFinishingProcess. Finishing process that uses mechanical treatment to modify the physical properties, surface behaviour, handling or appearance of textile materials or products.

Proposal: eutex:MechanicalRecyclingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:MechanicalRecyclingProcess. Recycling process that mechanically transforms textile products or waste into reusable fibres or materials.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-repairabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:ModularityFeature (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ModularityFeature. Design feature by which relevant product elements are modular, detachable or interchangeable to support repair or upgrade.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Proposal: eutex:MoistureRetention (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:MoistureRetention. Physical fibre property describing the capacity of fibres to absorb or retain moisture.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-associate.notes: Proposal: eutex:NonTextileComponent (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:NonTextileComponent. A physical component integrated into a textile product that is not part of the primary textile fibre composition, such as a button, zipper or sequin.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-soc#NonTe.notes: Proposal: eutex:NonTextileComponentMaterialGroup (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:NonTextileComponentMaterialGroup. Material grouping associated with one or more non‑textile components, used as a location or concentration reference unit without treating the component itself as a material group.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-associate.notes: Proposal: eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:NonTextileComponentTypeConcept. A controlled SKOS concept used to classify the functional type of a non‑textile component integrated into a textile product, such as button, zipper or sequin.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#N.notes: Proposal: eutex:NonwovenManufacturingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:NonwovenManufacturingProcess. Fabric manufacturing process that produces non‑woven textile structures by bonding or entangling fibres or filaments.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-assessmen.notes: Proposal: eutex:NumberOfCycles (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:NumberOfCycles. A measurement parameter specifying the number of repeated test, washing, abrasion or simulated‑use cycles performed during an assessment.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:ObservedDegradationPhenomenon (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ObservedDegradationPhenomenon. Observable physical deterioration of a textile material or product, distinct from the performance characteristic that measures resistance to such degradation.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-associate.notes: Proposal: eutex:PackagingMaterial (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:PackagingMaterial. A material occurrence used for the packaging, transport, storage or delivery of a textile product.
Proposal: eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:PackagingMaterialTypeConcept. A controlled SKOS concept used to classify a packaging material occurrence.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#P.notes: Proposal: eutex:PackagingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:PackagingProcess. Process that uses packaging material as an input within a textile manufacturing context, distinguishing it from ordinary textile production.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-assessmen.notes: Proposal: eutex:PerformanceThreshold (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:PerformanceThreshold. A decision criterion specifying a minimum, maximum, target or equality value against which an assessment result is evaluated.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:Pilling (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:Pilling. Observed surface degradation where small balls or pills of entangled fibres form on a textile during wear, friction, use or testing.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#P.notes: Proposal: eutex:PolycottonThermoChemicalRecyclingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:PolycottonThermoChemicalRecyclingProcess. Chemical or thermo‑chemical recycling process for polycotton blends that produces cellulosic pulp, polyester fibres, polymers or monomers depending on the applied technique.

Proposal: eutex:PrintingBinderUse (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:PrintingBinderUse. Use of a binder substance or chemical in the printing process, recorded as a process‑use aspect within TEXTILE_ASSOCIATED_MATERIALS.
Proposal: eutex:PrintingParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:PrintingParameter. Process parameter relevant to textile printing, such as temperature, pressure or ink composition.
Proposal: eutex:PrintingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:PrintingProcess. Textile process that applies colour, patterns or markings to textile materials or products.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-repairabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:PriorityRepairElement (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:PriorityRepairElement. Assessment role assigned to a product element that is important for repairability because of failure frequency or functional relevance.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#P.notes: Proposal: eutex:ProcessControlParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ProcessControlParameter. Parameter that controls, configures or monitors the execution conditions of a textile process.
Proposal: eutex:ProcessMethodConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ProcessMethodConcept. Controlled value representing a textile process method or technique.

Proposal: eutex:ProcessParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ProcessParameter. Semantic type for a configurable process condition, method choice, control variable or target specification relevant to a textile process.

Proposal: eutex:ProcessParameterSetting (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ProcessParameterSetting. Concrete value or selected category assigned to a process parameter for a specific textile process execution.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:ProductAgeing (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ProductAgeing. Progressive change or degradation of textile product performance over time under repeated use, care, environmental exposure or stress.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-indicator.notes: Proposal: eutex:ProductReplacementFrequency (class) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:ProductReplacementFrequency. Indicator of how often a product is replaced, recognising that replacement depends on durability, fit, perceived value and fashion trends.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-connector.notes: Proposal: eutex:ProductTechnologyLevelConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ProductTechnologyLevelConcept. A controlled concept classifying a product technology as base case, best‑available technology or best‑not‑yet‑available technology.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#P.notes: Proposal: eutex:PyrolysisGasificationRecyclingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:PyrolysisGasificationRecyclingProcess. Thermo‑chemical process that converts textile waste into syngas or pyrolysis oil for use as a feedstock in material production.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:RadiationInducedDegradation (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RadiationInducedDegradation. Degradation of textile material or product properties caused by exposure to ultraviolet or other relevant radiation.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-assessmen.notes: Proposal: eutex:RatingScale (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RatingScale. An interpretation scale composed of controlled rating values or grades used to evaluate assessment results.
Proposal: eutex:RatingValueConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RatingValueConcept. A controlled rating value, grade or scale level used as a SKOS concept in textile assessment results.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-recyclabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:RecoveredMaterialQualityResult (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RecoveredMaterialQualityResult. Assessment result indicating whether recovered textile material meets the quality requirements for its intended use.

Proposal: eutex:RecoveredTextileMaterial (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RecoveredTextileMaterial. Material output recovered from an actual textile recycling process and potentially usable as input to another production process.

Proposal: eutex:RecyclabilityBarrier (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RecyclabilityBarrier. Product, material, substance, information or system condition that hinders collection, sorting, preparation, recycling or the use and quality of recovered material for a specified route.
Proposal: eutex:RecyclabilityBarrierTypeConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RecyclabilityBarrierTypeConcept. Controlled concept classifying a recyclability barrier.
Proposal: eutex:RecyclabilityLabelConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RecyclabilityLabelConcept. Controlled categorical label used by a specified recyclability scoring method.

Proposal: eutex:RecycledContentAssessment (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RecycledContentAssessment. Execution of an assessment that verifies or evaluates a recycled‑content declaration for a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:RecycledContentAssessmentResult (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RecycledContentAssessmentResult. Result of verifying or evaluating a recycled‑content declaration for a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:RecycledContentPerformanceThreshold (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RecycledContentPerformanceThreshold. Minimum recycled‑content value required for a product, fibre or source context.

Proposal: eutex:RecycledContentVerificationMethod (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RecycledContentVerificationMethod. Method used to verify a recycled‑content declaration when direct lab determination of fibre origin is not feasible at scale.

Proposal: eutex:RecycledTextileFibre (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RecycledTextileFibre. Recovered textile material represented as a fibre suitable for use in textile products, meeting quality and process requirements.
Proposal: eutex:RecyclingLoopConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RecyclingLoopConcept. Controlled concept identifying the intended material‑loop destination of a recycling route.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#R.notes: Proposal: eutex:RecyclingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RecyclingProcess. End‑of‑life process that transforms textile products, waste or recovered materials into reusable fibre or material feedstock.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-connector.notes: Proposal: eutex:ReferencePeriod (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ReferencePeriod. A structured temporal interval that specifies the period to which an observation, indicator or other time‑bound textile statement applies.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-repairabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:RefurbishmentPossibility (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RefurbishmentPossibility. Ability of a product or discarded product to be prepared, cleaned, tested, serviced and, where necessary, repaired so that performance or functionality is restored within the originally intended use and performance range.

Proposal: eutex:RefurbishmentProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RefurbishmentProcess. Process involving preparation, cleaning, testing, servicing and, where necessary, repair to restore a textile product within its originally intended use and performance range.

Proposal: eutex:RemanufacturingPossibility (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RemanufacturingPossibility. Possibility of producing a new product from waste objects, products or components through actions involving at least one change that may affect the product performance, purpose or type.

Proposal: eutex:RemanufacturingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RemanufacturingProcess. Process producing a new textile product from waste objects, products or components, with at least one change that may affect performance, purpose or type. It is distinct from material recycling.

Proposal: eutex:RepairActionTypeConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RepairActionTypeConcept. Controlled process‑method concept identifying a textile repair action such as patching, mending, button replacement or zipper replacement.
Proposal: eutex:RepairActorTypeConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RepairActorTypeConcept. SKOS concept used to classify the role or category of an actor participating in textile repair.

Proposal: eutex:RepairCostCondition (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RepairCostCondition. Economic condition describing repair cost in relation to a comparable new product price and its influence on a repair decision.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#R.notes: Proposal: eutex:RepairProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RepairProcess. Process that extends the usable lifetime of a textile product through repair activities.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-repairabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:RepairRelatedProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RepairRelatedProcess. Textile process type related to upgrade, refurbishment or remanufacturing and organised with repair under the broader family of life‑extension interventions.

Proposal: eutex:RepairServiceConfigurationConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RepairServiceConfigurationConcept. SKOS concept representing a BC, BAT or BNAT repair‑service and guidance configuration from JRC Table 48.

Proposal: eutex:RepairabilityContextCondition (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RepairabilityContextCondition. Assessment condition external to intrinsic product design that influences repair feasibility or the decision to repair.

Proposal: eutex:RepairabilityDesignFeature (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RepairabilityDesignFeature. Design‑related feature that may enable repair, upgrade, refurbishment or remanufacturing, such as modularity, standardisation or disassembly.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#R.notes: Proposal: eutex:ReuseProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:ReuseProcess. End‑of‑life or post‑use process that enables a textile product to be used again without major material transformation.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:RoughOrStiffFabric (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:RoughOrStiffFabric. Failure mode in which a fabric becomes or is perceived as rough, stiff or unpleasant to touch, affecting user acceptance and comfort-related use.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#S.notes: Proposal: eutex:SeamConstructionParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SeamConstructionParameter. Sewing parameter describing seam type, stitch, thread, construction or other seam‑related configuration.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:SeamFailure (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SeamFailure. Structural or assembly‑related failure mode involving loss of seam integrity or functionality.

Proposal: eutex:SeamSlippage (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SeamSlippage. Durability‑related assembly performance characteristic describing displacement of yarns at or near a seam under mechanical stress, which may lead to deformation or opening.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-structure.notes: Proposal: eutex:SeamStrength (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SeamStrength. Mechanical property of a textile assembly describing the strength or integrity of a seam.
Proposal: eutex:SewingCharacteristic (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SewingCharacteristic. Assembly property describing the quality or construction of sewing in a textile product.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#S.notes: Proposal: eutex:SewingParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SewingParameter. Confectioning parameter relevant to sewing operations and seam formation.
Proposal: eutex:SewingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SewingProcess. Confectioning process joining textile parts or components using stitches or seams.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-recyclabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:SortingForRecyclingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SortingForRecyclingProcess. End‑of‑life process in which collected textile products or materials are segregated into streams suitable for subsequent recycling routes.
Proposal: eutex:SortingTechniqueConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SortingTechniqueConcept. SKOS concept used to classify a textile sorting technique.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#S.notes: Proposal: eutex:SpinSpeed (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SpinSpeed. Care parameter describing the spin speed used in laundering.

Proposal: eutex:SpinningLimit (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SpinningLimit. Process parameter expressing the range of yarn counts achievable from a given fibre using a specific spinning system; it depends on the number and thickness of fibres or filaments twisted together.
Proposal: eutex:SpinningMethodConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SpinningMethodConcept. SKOS concept used as a controlled value for a spinning method.

Proposal: eutex:SpinningMethodParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SpinningMethodParameter. When the selected method is represented directly as a controlled value on a spinning process, use txtprc:hasSpinningMethod with a txtprc:SpinningMethodConcept. This class is retained only when the method must be treated explicitly as a process parameter.
Proposal: eutex:SpinningParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SpinningParameter. Process parameter relevant to spinning or yarn manufacturing.

Proposal: eutex:SpinningProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SpinningProcess. Specific spinning techniques such as ring spinning, rotor open‑end spinning and air‑jet spinning are represented as SKOS concepts in the spinning method scheme.

Proposal: eutex:SpinningProductivity (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SpinningProductivity. Process parameter expressing the finest yarn count producible from a given fibre while maintaining acceptable performance and minimising end‑breakage rates.
Proposal: eutex:SpinningSpeed (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SpinningSpeed. Process parameter describing the speed of spinning.
Proposal: eutex:SpinningTension (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SpinningTension. Process parameter describing tension during spinning.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-repairabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:StandardisationFeature (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:StandardisationFeature. Design feature by which components or interfaces are standardised in a way that may support replacement, repair or upgrade.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#S.notes: Proposal: eutex:StorageConditionParameter (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:StorageConditionParameter. Care parameter describing storage‑related conditions, such as humidity, sunlight exposure, folding or hanging.

Proposal: eutex:StorageProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:StorageProcess. Use‑phase or care‑related process involving storage of a textile product under specified or unspecified conditions.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:StructuralFailureMode (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:StructuralFailureMode. Category of failure modes primarily affecting structure, integrity or dimensional behaviour.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-core#Stud.notes: Proposal: eutex:StudyScopeStatusConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:StudyScopeStatusConcept. A SKOS concept used to indicate whether a textile product type is included in, excluded from, or otherwise qualified with respect to a study or regulatory modelling scope.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:SurfaceDegradationPhenomenon (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SurfaceDegradationPhenomenon. Observed degradation phenomenon affecting the surface condition of a textile material or product, such as pilling, fuzzing or matting.

Proposal: eutex:SurfaceFailureMode (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SurfaceFailureMode. Category of failure modes primarily affecting the textile surface, distinct from performance parameters that are captured under Observed Degradation Phenomenon.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#S.notes: Proposal: eutex:SyntheticFibreChemicalRecyclingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:SyntheticFibreChemicalRecyclingProcess. Chemical recycling process for synthetic textile feedstock such as polyester or polyamide 6, producing recovered monomers, oligomers or polymers.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:TactileFailureMode (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TactileFailureMode. Category of failure modes primarily affecting tactile perception, hand feel or comfort‑related touch properties of a textile product or fabric.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#T.notes: Proposal: eutex:TargetFabricDensity (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TargetFabricDensity. Process target specification stating the intended thread or loop density of the resulting fabric.

Proposal: eutex:TargetFabricMassPerUnitArea (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TargetFabricMassPerUnitArea. Process target specification stating the intended mass of fabric per unit surface area.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:TearOrRip (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TearOrRip. Mechanical failure mode involving rupture, tearing or ripping of textile material under stress, snagging or damage.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-assessmen.notes: Proposal: eutex:TestCondition (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TestCondition. A controlled assessment condition used in a test protocol, such as temperature, humidity, load, duration, washing cycle or abrasion cycle.

Proposal: eutex:TestEndpoint (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TestEndpoint. A defined observation or stopping condition used to determine when a textile test is complete, such as specimen breakdown or a specified appearance change.
Proposal: eutex:TestExecution (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TestExecution. An assessment execution that performs a textile test method under controlled test conditions.

Proposal: eutex:TestMethod (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TestMethod. An assessment method that applies a controlled experimental or inspection procedure to a durability‑related performance parameter.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-associate.notes: Proposal: eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept. A controlled concept describing the technical function performed by a chemical in textile production or treatment.

Proposal: eutex:TextileChemicalSubstance (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileChemicalSubstance. A substance used or occurring in textile manufacturing, treatment, finishing, coating or related production contexts.

Proposal: eutex:TextileChemicalUseCategoryConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileChemicalUseCategoryConcept. A controlled concept describing whether a chemical is intended to act during processing, remain for product performance, or occur unintentionally.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-soc#Texti.notes: Proposal: eutex:TextileConcentrationInformation (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileConcentrationInformation. Concentration information for a substance present in a textile product, expressed at product, component, material‑group or spare‑part level as an exact value, maximum value or range.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-context#T.notes: Proposal: eutex:TextileContextFactorConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileContextFactorConcept. A SKOS concept identifying the type of contextual condition observed or declared for a textile product or process execution.

Proposal: eutex:TextileContextObservation (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileContextObservation. A concrete observation, declaration or setting of a contextual condition applying to a textile product or a textile process execution.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-core#Text.notes: Proposal: eutex:TextileFibre (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileFibre. A unit of matter characterised by flexibility, fineness and a high length‑to‑width ratio, suitable for textile applications.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#T.notes: Proposal: eutex:TextileManufacturingProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileManufacturingProcess. Process involved in the manufacturing or transformation of textile fibres, yarns, fabrics, assemblies or finished textile products.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-soc#Texti.notes: Proposal: eutex:TextileMaterialGroup (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileMaterialGroup. A fibre‑, yarn‑ or fabric‑based material grouping within a textile product that serves as a location or mass‑reference unit for substance reporting.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#T.notes: Proposal: eutex:TextileProcess (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileProcess. Process involved in manufacturing, transforming, using, caring for, repairing, reusing, recycling or treating a textile product, including components used in other products.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-soc#Texti.notes: Proposal: eutex:TextileProductGroupSoCReference (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileProductGroupSoCReference. A versioned reference identifying the textile‑product‑group source that qualifies a substance under the product‑group‑specific type (d) criterion.

Proposal: eutex:TextileRecyclingAlertThreshold (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileRecyclingAlertThreshold. A textile‑sector alert concentration used to inform sorting, recycling or environmentally sound end‑of‑life handling when the substance may hinder circular treatment.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-repairabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:TextileRefurbishmentEvent (class) skos:broadMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileRefurbishmentEvent. Concrete occurrence of a textile refurbishment that is both an instance of the EU DPP RefurbishmentEvent semantics and a textile process execution.

Proposal: eutex:TextileRemanufacturingEvent (class) skos:broadMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileRemanufacturingEvent. Concrete occurrence of a textile remanufacturing that is both an instance of the EU DPP RemanufacturingEvent semantics and a textile process execution.

Proposal: eutex:TextileRepairEvent (class) skos:broadMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileRepairEvent. Concrete occurrence of a textile repair that is both an instance of the EU DPP RepairEvent semantics and a textile process execution.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-soc#Texti.notes: Proposal: eutex:TextileSoCHandlingInformation (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileSoCHandlingInformation. Textile‑specific instruction information concerning safe use and lifecycle handling in the presence of a substance of concern, covering disassembly, preparation for reuse, reuse, recycling and environmentally sound end‑of‑life management; repair guidance may be added as a textile/JRC extension.

Proposal: eutex:TextileSoCLocationTypeConcept (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileSoCLocationTypeConcept. Controlled concept describing a textile‑specific kind of product location used to qualify a substance location statement.

Proposal: eutex:TextileSubstanceOfConcernPresenceContext (class) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileSubstanceOfConcernPresenceContext. Specialised context for a textile product, textile material group or non‑textile component indicating where and how a substance of concern is present.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-durabilit.notes: Proposal: eutex:typicalProgressionTo (property, range xsd:string) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:typicalProgressionTo. Annotation used at class level to document a typical degradation progression without asserting a mandatory causal relation.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-connector.notes: Proposal: eutex:typicallyContributesTo (property, range xsd:string) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:typicallyContributesTo. Proposal: eutex:typicallyIncreasesLikelihoodOf (property, range xsd:string) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:typicallyIncreasesLikelihoodOf. https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-context#t.notes: Proposal: eutex:typicallyQualifiesProcess (property) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:typicallyQualifiesProcess. https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-connector.notes: Proposal: eutex:typicallyReducesLikelihoodOf (property, range xsd:string) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:typicallyReducesLikelihoodOf. Weak annotation relation indicating that a source entity typically reduces the likelihood of a target degradation phenomenon, failure mode, damage mechanism or adverse outcome.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#t.notes: Proposal: eutex:typicallyUsesChemicalFunction (property) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:typicallyUsesChemicalFunction. Indicates that a textile process type usually employs a particular chemical function represented in Textile Associated Materials.

Proposal: eutex:typicallyUsesChemicalUseCategory (property, range eutex:TextileChemicalUseCategoryConcept) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:typicallyUsesChemicalUseCategory. Weak annotation indicating that a textile process type usually employs chemicals from a specific use category represented in Textile Associated Materials.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#u.notes: Proposal: eutex:usesChemicalUseCategory (property, range eutex:TextileChemicalUseCategoryConcept) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:usesChemicalUseCategory. Relates a textile process type or execution to the use category of a chemical employed in that process, such as process or performance chemical.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-recyclabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:usesCollectionScheme (property, range eutex:CollectionSchemeConcept) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:usesCollectionScheme. Relates a collection‑for‑recycling process type or configuration to the collection scheme it employs. CHECK: eutex:CollectionForRecyclingProcess is not an existing or proposed class.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-process#u.notes: Proposal: eutex:usesInput (property, range eutex:TextileProduct) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:usesInput. Relates a textile process type or execution to an input such as a textile product, non‑textile component, material of composition, chemical substance or packaging material used in that process.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-recyclabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:usesPreTreatmentTechnique (property, range eutex:PreTreatmentTechniqueConcept) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:usesPreTreatmentTechnique. Relates a preparation‑for‑recycling process to the pre‑treatment technique it employs. CHECK: eutex:PreparationForRecyclingProcess, eutex:PreTreatmentTechniqueConcept is not an existing or proposed class.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-repairabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:usesRepairBehaviourObservation (property, range eutex:TextileContextObservation) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:usesRepairBehaviourObservation. Links a repairability assessment to the textile context observation that records observed repair behaviour. CHECK: eutex:RepairabilityAssessment is not an existing or proposed class.

Proposal: eutex:usesReusableTextileInput (property, range eutex:TextileProduct) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:usesReusableTextileInput. Links a refurbishment or remanufacturing execution to the textile product that is used as reusable input, including components of another product. CHECK: eutex:TextileProcessExecution is not an existing or proposed class.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-recyclabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:usesSortingTechnique (property, range eutex:SortingTechniqueConcept) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:usesSortingTechnique. Relates a sorting‑for‑recycling process to the sorting technique it employs.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-repairabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:usesSpareComponent (property, range eutex:NonTextileComponent) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:usesSpareComponent. https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-recyclabi.notes: Proposal: eutex:verifiesRecycledContentDeclaration (property, range eutex:RecycledContentDeclaration) skos:closeMatch cirpass2-textile:verifiesRecycledContentDeclaration. Relates a recycled‑content assessment result to the declaration it verifies.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-assessmen.notes: Proposal: eutex:ThresholdComparisonOperatorScheme (skos:ConceptScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:ThresholdComparisonOperatorScheme. Controlled vocabulary of comparison operators used by performance thresholds.

Proposal: eutex:GreaterThan (individual of eutex:ThresholdComparisonOperatorConcept, in eutex:ThresholdComparisonOperatorScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:greaterThan. The measured or assessed value must be greater than the threshold value.

Proposal: eutex:GreaterThanOrEqualTo (individual of eutex:ThresholdComparisonOperatorConcept, in eutex:ThresholdComparisonOperatorScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:greaterThanOrEqualTo. The measured or assessed value must be greater than or equal to the threshold value.

Proposal: eutex:LessThan (individual of eutex:ThresholdComparisonOperatorConcept, in eutex:ThresholdComparisonOperatorScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:lessThan. The measured or assessed value must be lower than the threshold value.

Proposal: eutex:LessThanOrEqualTo (individual of eutex:ThresholdComparisonOperatorConcept, in eutex:ThresholdComparisonOperatorScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:lessThanOrEqualTo. The measured or assessed value must be lower than or equal to the threshold value.

https://w3id.org/eudpp/textile-associate.notes: Proposal: eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeScheme (skos:ConceptScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:NonTextileComponentTypeScheme. Controlled vocabulary of functional types of non-textile components integrated into textile products.

Proposal: eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeScheme (skos:ConceptScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:PackagingMaterialTypeScheme. Controlled vocabulary of material types used for textile-product packaging.

Proposal: eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme (skos:ConceptScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme. Controlled vocabulary of technical functions performed by chemical substances in textile manufacturing, treatment, finishing or functionalisation.

Proposal: eutex:TextileChemicalUseCategoryScheme (skos:ConceptScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileChemicalUseCategoryScheme. Controlled vocabulary distinguishing process chemicals, performance chemicals and unintended chemical substances.

Proposal: eutex:AcidDye (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:acidDye. Dye function corresponding to acid dyes used for compatible fibre types such as wool, silk or polyamide.

Proposal: eutex:AcidOrAlkali (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:acidOrAlkali. Chemical function involving pH adjustment or chemical treatment during textile preparation, dyeing or finishing.

Proposal: eutex:AntimicrobialAgent (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:antimicrobialAgent. Chemical function intended to prevent or limit growth of microorganisms on textile materials or products.

Proposal: eutex:BasicDye (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:basicDye. Dye function corresponding to basic or cationic dyes used for compatible fibre types such as acrylic fibres.

Proposal: eutex:Biocide (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:biocide. Chemical function involving biocidal activity. Depending on use, a biocide may be a process chemical, such as a preservative, or a performance chemical intended to remain in the article.

Proposal: eutex:BleachingAgent (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:bleachingAgent. Chemical function involving bleaching or decolourising textile materials during preparation or finishing.

Proposal: eutex:Buckle (individual of eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeConcept, in eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:buckle. A buckle integrated into a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:Button (individual of eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeConcept, in eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:button. A button integrated into a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:CardboardPackagingMaterial (individual of eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeConcept, in eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:cardboardPackagingMaterial. Packaging material made primarily of cardboard.

Proposal: eutex:DecorativeHardware (individual of eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeConcept, in eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:decorativeHardware. Decorative non-textile hardware integrated into a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:DisperseDye (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:disperseDye. Dye function corresponding to disperse dyes used for compatible synthetic fibres.

Proposal: eutex:DispersingAgent (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:dispersingAgent. Chemical function involving dispersion of dyes, pigments or other substances in a textile-processing formulation.

Proposal: eutex:Dye (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:dye. Chemical function involving imparting colour to textile fibres, yarns, fabrics or finished textile products.

Proposal: eutex:FinishingAgent (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:finishingAgent. Chemical function involving modification of appearance, handle or functional behaviour during textile finishing.

Proposal: eutex:FixingAgent (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:fixingAgent. Chemical function involving improved fixation of a dye or finishing substance on a textile material.

Proposal: eutex:FlameRetardant (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:flameRetardant. Chemical function intended to reduce flammability or delay ignition and flame propagation in a textile material.

Proposal: eutex:HookAndLoopFastener (individual of eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeConcept, in eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:hookAndLoopFastener. A hook-and-loop fastening component integrated into a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:LevellingAgent (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:levellingAgent. Chemical function involving promotion of uniform dye uptake or colour distribution during dyeing.

Proposal: eutex:MetalRivet (individual of eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeConcept, in eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:metalRivet. A metal rivet integrated into a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:PaperPackagingMaterial (individual of eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeConcept, in eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:paperPackagingMaterial. Packaging material made primarily of paper.

Proposal: eutex:PerformanceChemical (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalUseCategoryConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalUseCategoryScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:performanceChemical. A chemical intended to remain in the final textile article at a concentration needed to provide a desired function.

Proposal: eutex:Pigment (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:pigment. Chemical function involving imparting colour through a pigment used in textile printing, coating or related treatment.

Proposal: eutex:PlasticPackagingMaterial (individual of eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeConcept, in eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:plasticPackagingMaterial. Packaging material made primarily of plastic.

Proposal: eutex:PolyethylenePackagingMaterial (individual of eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeConcept, in eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:polyethylenePackagingMaterial. Plastic packaging material made from polyethylene.

Proposal: eutex:PolyethyleneTerephthalatePackagingMaterial (individual of eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeConcept, in eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:polyethyleneTerephthalatePackagingMaterial. Plastic packaging material made from polyethylene terephthalate.

Proposal: eutex:PolypropylenePackagingMaterial (individual of eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeConcept, in eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:polypropylenePackagingMaterial. Plastic packaging material made from polypropylene.

Proposal: eutex:PolyvinylChloridePackagingMaterial (individual of eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeConcept, in eutex:PackagingMaterialTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:polyvinylChloridePackagingMaterial. Plastic packaging material made from polyvinyl chloride. The vocabulary term does not imply that this material satisfies an applicable packaging requirement.

Proposal: eutex:PrintedLabelOrTag (individual of eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeConcept, in eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:printedLabelOrTag. A printed label or tag integrated into or attached to a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:ProcessChemical (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalUseCategoryConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalUseCategoryScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:processChemical. A chemical used during textile processing and not intended to remain in the final textile product.

Proposal: eutex:Sequin (individual of eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeConcept, in eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:sequin. A sequin integrated into a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:SizingAgent (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:sizingAgent. Chemical function involving application of sizing to improve yarn strength, smoothness or processability.

Proposal: eutex:SnapFastener (individual of eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeConcept, in eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:snapFastener. A snap fastener integrated into a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:Softener (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:softener. Chemical function involving improvement of textile handle or drape. A softener may be used as an auxiliary or may remain as a finishing chemical, depending on the process.

Proposal: eutex:Solvent (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:solvent. Chemical function involving dissolution or carrying of other substances in textile processing.

Proposal: eutex:StainRepellent (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:stainRepellent. Chemical function intended to reduce retention or penetration of stains in a textile material.

Proposal: eutex:Surfactant (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:surfactant. Chemical function involving reduction of surface tension in a textile-processing operation.

Proposal: eutex:UnintendedChemical (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalUseCategoryConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalUseCategoryScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:unintendedChemical. A contaminant or degradation product not intended to remain in the finished textile and having no intended function in textile processing or in the final product.

Proposal: eutex:UvAbsorberOrStabiliser (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:uvAbsorberOrStabiliser. Chemical function covering ultraviolet absorbers or stabilisers added to reduce radiation-induced degradation of textile materials.

Proposal: eutex:UvProtectant (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:uvProtectant. Chemical function intended to protect a textile material from ultraviolet radiation or related degradation.

Proposal: eutex:WaterRepellent (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:waterRepellent. Chemical function intended to confer water repellency to a textile material.

Proposal: eutex:WettingAgent (individual of eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionConcept, in eutex:TextileChemicalFunctionScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:wettingAgent. Surfactant function intended to improve wetting or liquid penetration of textile fibres, yarns or fabrics during wet processing.

Proposal: eutex:Zipper (individual of eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeConcept, in eutex:NonTextileComponentTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:zipper. A zipper integrated into a textile product.
