Proposal: eutex:StudyScopeStatusScheme (skos:ConceptScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:StudyScopeStatusScheme. Controlled vocabulary for representing the status of a textile product type with respect to the JRC preparatory study scope.

Proposal: eutex:TextileApparelProductTypeScheme (skos:ConceptScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:TextileApparelProductTypeScheme. Controlled vocabulary representing the textile apparel categories of JRC Table 7. The JRC categories are aligned with the PEFCR Apparel and Footwear work but this scheme does not claim identity with the complete PEFCR segmentation.

Proposal: eutex:Acetate (individual of eutex:FiberType, in eutex:FibreTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:acetate. A man-made cellulosic fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres. CHECK: upstream mixes the fibre groups of Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 Annex I with specific fibres; the specific fibres we already have (eutex:Cotton …) are set to map, the group values are broader, so add skos:broader from ours.
eutex:Acrylic already exists in eu/textile; map it to cirpass2-textile:acrylic instead of drafting a second one.

Proposal: eutex:AnimalOriginFibre (individual of eutex:FiberType, in eutex:FibreTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:animalOriginFibre. A natural-origin textile fibre category that includes wool, silk and hair. CHECK: upstream mixes the fibre groups of Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 Annex I with specific fibres; the specific fibres we already have (eutex:Cotton …) are set to map, the group values are broader, so add skos:broader from ours.

Proposal: eutex:Belt (individual of eutex:ApparelSubcategory, in eutex:TextileApparelProductTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:belt. CHECK: overlaps the ten existing eutex:ApparelSubcategory individuals; merge rather than duplicate.

Proposal: eutex:ChemicalFibre (individual of eutex:FiberType, in eutex:FibreTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:chemicalFibre. CHECK: upstream mixes the fibre groups of Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 Annex I with specific fibres; the specific fibres we already have (eutex:Cotton …) are set to map, the group values are broader, so add skos:broader from ours.
eutex:Cotton already exists in eu/textile; map it to cirpass2-textile:cotton instead of drafting a second one.

Proposal: eutex:Cupro (individual of eutex:FiberType, in eutex:FibreTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:cupro. CHECK: upstream mixes the fibre groups of Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 Annex I with specific fibres; the specific fibres we already have (eutex:Cotton …) are set to map, the group values are broader, so add skos:broader from ours.

Proposal: eutex:DressSkirtOrJumpsuit (individual of eutex:ApparelSubcategory, in eutex:TextileApparelProductTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:dressSkirtOrJumpsuit. CHECK: overlaps the ten existing eutex:ApparelSubcategory individuals; merge rather than duplicate.
eutex:Elastane already exists in eu/textile; map it to cirpass2-textile:elastane instead of drafting a second one.

Proposal: eutex:ExcludedFromJRCPreparatoryStudyScope (individual of eutex:StudyScopeStatusConcept, in eutex:StudyScopeStatusScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:excludedFromJRCPreparatoryStudyScope. Study scope status indicating that the textile product type is excluded from the JRC preparatory study scope without implying that it is not a textile product.

Proposal: eutex:Flax (individual of eutex:FiberType, in eutex:FibreTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:flax. CHECK: upstream mixes the fibre groups of Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 Annex I with specific fibres; the specific fibres we already have (eutex:Cotton …) are set to map, the group values are broader, so add skos:broader from ours.

Proposal: eutex:GloveOrMitten (individual of eutex:ApparelSubcategory, in eutex:TextileApparelProductTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:gloveOrMitten. CHECK: overlaps the ten existing eutex:ApparelSubcategory individuals; merge rather than duplicate.

Proposal: eutex:Hair (individual of eutex:FiberType, in eutex:FibreTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:hair. CHECK: upstream mixes the fibre groups of Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 Annex I with specific fibres; the specific fibres we already have (eutex:Cotton …) are set to map, the group values are broader, so add skos:broader from ours.

Textile apparel accessory used to cover the head for warmth or as a fashion item, including caps, flat caps, woollen hats, beanies, fedoras, panamas, bowlers, newsboys and berets. CHECK: overlaps the ten existing eutex:ApparelSubcategory individuals; merge rather than duplicate.

Proposal: eutex:IncludedInJRCPreparatoryStudyScope (individual of eutex:StudyScopeStatusConcept, in eutex:StudyScopeStatusScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:includedInJRCPreparatoryStudyScope. Study scope status indicating that the textile product type is included in the JRC preparatory study scope.

Proposal: eutex:JacketOrCoat (individual of eutex:ApparelSubcategory, in eutex:TextileApparelProductTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:jacketOrCoat. Proposal: eutex:NonPPEWorkwear (individual of eutex:ApparelSubcategory, in eutex:TextileApparelProductTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:nonPPEWorkwear. Workwear included in the JRC preparatory study scope when it is not classified as personal protective equipment. CHECK: overlaps the ten existing eutex:ApparelSubcategory individuals; merge rather than duplicate.

Proposal: eutex:PantsOrShorts (individual of eutex:ApparelSubcategory, in eutex:TextileApparelProductTypeScheme) skos:exactMatch cirpass2-textile:pantsOrShorts.
